description: AI workforce governance control plane. 29 governed MCP tools for decision classification (MAI framework), compliance scoring, audit chain verification, risk assessment, and multi-vendor AI governance. Built for enterprise AI compliance including NIST 800-53, CMMC 2.0, EU AI Act, and SOC 2. Every AI action is classified, audited, and governed through one contract.

tools.name: classify_decision
tools.description: Classify an AI agent decision using the MAI Framework (Mandatory/Advisory/Informational). Returns classification level, confidence score, gate requirements, and rationale.

decision.description: Description of the decision to classify

agent_name.description: Name of the agent making the decision

tools.name: evaluate_threshold
tools.description: Compute the Storey Threshold — escalation rate (gates required / total operations). Returns current rate, status, and recommendations. Healthy band 10-18% is a design heuristic, not empirically validated.

tools.name: score_governance
tools.description: Compute weighted governance score from caller-provided Integrity, Accuracy, and Compliance values (0-1). Returns weighted composite and pass/fail against configured thresholds. Scores are caller-assessed — this tool applies weights and thresholds, not independent evaluation.

operation.description: Name of the operation being scored

tools.name: audit_pipeline
tools.description: Query the audit ledger for governance entries. Search by operation name or retrieve recent entries. Returns hash-chained audit trail with MAI classification context.

tools.name: monitor_agents
tools.description: Monitor the status and health of all governed AI agents. Returns supervisor state, repair history, and failure counts.

tools.name: map_compliance
tools.description: Map GIA governance components to regulatory compliance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001, NIST 800-53, LINDDUN, MITRE ATLAS). Shows which controls are implemented.

tools.name: assess_risk_tier
tools.description: Assess the risk tier of an AI system using rule-based mapping to EU AI Act categories (Unacceptable, High, Limited, Minimal). Returns tier and MAI governance recommendations. Classification is heuristic, not a legal determination.

system_description.description: Description of the AI system or operation

affects_individuals.description: Whether the system makes decisions affecting individuals

autonomous_decisions.description: Whether the system makes autonomous decisions

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a governance status report. Includes system health, threshold status, compliance coverage, and operational metrics.

tools.name: system_status
tools.description: Get full GIA system status including engine health, uptime, governance metrics, and configuration.

tools.name: approve_gate
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending MANDATORY gate decision. Lists pending gates if no gate_id provided. This is the human-in-the-loop mechanism for MANDATORY classifications.

gate_id.description: Gate ID to approve/reject (required for approve/reject)

webauthn_proof.description: Optional WebAuthn passkey proof for cryptographic identity verification

tools.name: seal_memory_pack
tools.description: Create and hash-seal a new Governed Memory Pack (GMP). The pack becomes an immutable, TTL-bound institutional knowledge artifact with trust level enforcement.

pack_id.description: Unique identifier for the memory pack

ttl_hours.description: TTL in hours (capped by trust level)

sealer_role.description: Role of the sealer (for trust level enforcement)

allowed_roles.description: RBAC roles allowed to load this pack

tools.name: load_memory_pack
tools.description: Load a Governed Memory Pack into agent context. Validates TTL, trust level, role access, context class, and hash integrity before loading.

tools.name: transfer_memory_pack
tools.description: Transfer a memory pack between agents via a governed knowledge corridor. Creates a derived pack with transfer provenance. ALWAYS requires MANDATORY gate — no silent transfers.

scope_filter.description: Optional: only transfer specific scope items

tools.name: compose_memory_packs
tools.description: Compose multiple memory packs into a unified execution context. Highest risk level wins, shortest TTL wins, roles intersect, trust level contaminates downward.

tools.name: distill_memory_pack
tools.description: Distill governance patterns from usage history into a draft heuristic pack. Returns EPHEMERAL draft that requires MANDATORY gate to approve for production use.

tools.name: promote_memory_pack
tools.description: Promote a memory pack to a higher trust level after human review. This is how distilled EPHEMERAL packs become CASE or ORG packs. Requires MANDATORY gate.

tools.name: record_value_metric
tools.description: Record a workflow value metric — tracks time saved, risk blocked, success rate, autonomy level, and task complexity for ROI reporting.

workflow_type.description: Type of workflow (e.g., claim-analysis, evidence-review, compliance-check)

tools.name: record_governance_event
tools.description: Record a governance event — tracks gates triggered, drift prevented, violations blocked, red team findings, and human interventions for impact reporting.

tools.name: generate_impact_report
tools.description: Generate a full economic + governance impact report. Returns pilot ROI data: time saved, cost avoided, risks blocked, success rate, autonomy trend, and confidence levels.

set_baselines.description: Optional: override default baselines for this report

tools.name: srt_run_watchdog
tools.description: Run real health check probes from the MCP container (API health, frontend, disk, memory, TLS cert, DB, DNS). Returns actual measured values — never uses AI-provided data. Classification: INFORMATIONAL — read-only, no side effects.

check_results.description: IGNORED — real probes are always used. This parameter exists for backward compatibility only.

tools.name: srt_diagnose
tools.description: Run the SRT Diagnostician on an incident. Matches finding to known playbooks, identifies root cause, and proposes a staged repair plan. Classification: ADVISORY — read-only analysis, no mutations.

additional_observations.description: Additional diagnostic observations (e.g. from manual log reading)

tools.name: srt_approve_repair
tools.description: Approve or reject a pending SRT repair plan. Classification: MANDATORY — this is the human-in-the-loop gate. Repair plans CANNOT execute without explicit human approval. Pass action="approve" to approve or action="reject" to reject.

action.description: Approve or reject the repair plan

tools.name: srt_generate_postmortem
tools.description: Generate a structured postmortem report for a completed SRT incident. Includes timeline, root cause, what worked/failed, prevention actions, metrics (TTD/TTDiag/TTR), and optional playbook delta. Classification: ADVISORY.

incident_id.description: Incident ID to generate postmortem for

tools.name: verify_ledger
tools.description: Verify the integrity of the hash-chained forensic audit ledger. Recomputes every SHA-256 hash from genesis and reports whether the chain is intact. Classification: INFORMATIONAL — read-only, no side effects.

tools.name: gia_scan_environment
tools.description: Run scout swarm to detect target environment — OS, containers, services, network, storage. Returns EnvironmentProfile for compatibility checking. Classification: INFORMATIONAL — read-only, no mutations. Scout outputs are redacted for sensitive content.

scout_data.description: Pre-collected scout data as key-value pairs. If not provided, returns scout command definitions for server-side execution.

tools.name: gia_list_packs
tools.description: List available governed operations packs. Filter by intent (remediation/patrol/hardening/audit), category, risk level, or trust level. Classification: INFORMATIONAL.

tools.name: gia_dry_run_pack
tools.description: Preview remediation pack execution — shows hydrated commands, compatibility check, validation, blast radius. Returns inputsHash for approval binding (what-you-approved-is-what-ran). Classification: ADVISORY — read-only preview, no execution.

pack_id.description: Remediation pack ID to preview (e.g. rpack-nginx-502-v1)

tools.name: gia_apply_pack
tools.description: Execute a remediation or hardening pack with MANDATORY gate approval. Requires inputsHash from gia_dry_run_pack (what-you-approved-is-what-ran binding). REJECTS patrol/audit packs (use gia_run_patrol for those). Hardening packs run preflight checks before execution. Classification: MANDATORY — human approval required.

pack_id.description: Remediation or hardening pack ID to execute

approved_by.description: Human approver identity (from authenticated session). BLOCKED: system, auto, agent, bot, ai

variable_overrides.description: Same variable overrides used in dry-run

tools.name: gia_run_patrol
tools.description: Execute a patrol or audit pack — read-only posture checks that produce findings or compliance evidence. Classification: ADVISORY for low/moderate sensitivity, MANDATORY for high sensitivity. REJECTS remediation/hardening packs (use gia_apply_pack for those). Audit packs produce deterministic pass/fail per NIST control — no AI interpretation.

pack_id.description: Patrol or audit pack ID (e.g. patrol-open-ports-v1, audit-nist-ac-basics-v1)

scout_data.description: Pre-collected command outputs keyed by step number (e.g. {"step_1": "output..."}). If not provided, returns command definitions for caller to execute.

approved_by.description: Required ONLY for high-sensitivity packs. Human approver identity.

arguments.name: system_description
arguments.description: Description of the AI system or operation to assess

arguments.name: domain
arguments.description: Industry domain (va-claims, legal, healthcare, finance, federal, general)

prompts.description: Design a MAI gate strategy for an AI agent pipeline. Recommends classification levels and gate enforcement for each stage.

arguments.name: pipeline_description
arguments.description: Description of the agent pipeline stages

prompts.description: Generate a comprehensive compliance report mapping GIA governance to regulatory frameworks.
